Bring everyone into the conversation this Christmas with 24 printable conversation cards. These holiday table talk questions combine playful choices, shared memories, festive favorites, and imaginative prompts for relaxed conversations with family and friends.

Set them out at Christmas dinner, draw a card during a holiday gathering, or use them as a simple party icebreaker. Just print, cut, and start talking!

WHAT YOU RECEIVE

• 24 different Christmas conversation cards
• 4 categories with 6 cards in each category
• 4 printable card sheets, with 6 cards per sheet
• 1 instruction page with printing directions and two ways to play
• A4 and US Letter PDF versions
• Cutting guides around each card

Each paper-size version contains 5 pages: 4 card sheets + 1 instruction page.

Both sizes contain the same 24 questions. You are receiving 24 unique cards, not 48 different cards.

EXPLORE THE FOUR CATEGORIES

THIS OR THAT?
Choose between two festive options and share your reasons.
Example: “Would you rather choose the gifts or wrap them? Why?”

TELL US A STORY
Share memorable gifts, funny moments, and holiday experiences.
Example: “Have you ever bought someone a gift and wanted to keep it? What was it?”

YOUR HOLIDAY FAVORITES
Talk about the food, movies, music, and traditions you enjoy.
Example: “What food do you most look forward to at a holiday meal?”

MAKE IT YOUR WAY
Imagine your own holiday plans, activities, and celebrations.
Example: “If you could serve only three dishes at a holiday meal, what would you choose?”

TWO EASY WAYS TO PLAY

OPEN CHAT
Take turns drawing a card and reading it aloud. Answer first, then let anyone who wants to join in share their answer.

PICK A PERSON
Draw a card, read it aloud, and answer first. You may invite one other person to answer the same question. They can always pass.

Skip any question, enjoy the conversation, and take your time. There are no scores or right or wrong answers.
